Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as same_date_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_days = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as zero_days_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_date,
        CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
        (CAST(final_game AS DATE) - CAST(debut AS DATE)) as total_days
    FROM player
    WHERE debut != '' AND final_game != ''
) sub

WITH player_spans AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        ABS(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(final_game AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(debut AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE)) as abs_years,
        ABS(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', CAST(final_game AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', CAST(debut AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE)) as abs_months,
        ABS(CAST(STRFTIME('%d', CAST(final_game AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(STRFTIME('%d', CAST(debut AS DATE)) AS DOUBLE)) as abs_days
    FROM player
    WHERE debut != '' AND final_game != ''
),
player_spans_rounded AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        ROUND(abs_years, 2) + ROUND(abs_months / 12.0, 2) + ROUND(abs_days / 365.0, 2) as career_span
    FROM player_spans
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) as avg_career_span,
    COUNT(*) as player_count
FROM player_spans_rounded
